Title: 484461-2026: France – Architectural and engineering services as well as surveying services – Construction of a departmental sports hall in CHÂTEL-GUYON - Project management (maîtrise d'oeuvre) mission
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction of a gymnasium/sports hall — sports buildings are generally of interest for sbp. Due to a lack of information on spans/complexity and because the project is in France (outside the DACH region), the priority is reduced.
titel: New construction of a departmental sports hall in Châtel-Guyon – General planning services
kurzbeschreibung: The Département Puy-de-Dôme has awarded the general planning services (maîtrise d'oeuvre) for the new construction of a departmental gymnasium/sports hall in Châtel-Guyon to the team GROUPEMENT CHANEAC / BECO.
wettbewerb_art: Award of general planning services (maîtrise d'oeuvre) in an open procedure
gewinner_rolle: General planner (architectural and engineering services, maîtrise d'oeuvre)
gewinner_kontakt: Contract value: 82560 EUR (maîtrise d'oeuvre fee); Address: 576 Chemin Des Teppes, 73190 Challes-Les-Eaux, France; E-mail: marche@atelier-chaneac.fr; Tel.: +33 4 79 35 21 96
projektbeteiligte:
Département du Puy-de-Dôme – Client (24, rue Saint Esprit, 63033 Clermont-Ferrand, France, servicedesmarches@puy-de-dome.fr, Tel.: +33 4 73 42 20 20)
GROUPEMENT CHANEAC / BECO – General planner/maîtrise d'oeuvre (architectural and engineering services, 576 Chemin Des Teppes, 73190 Challes-Les-Eaux, France, marche@atelier-chaneac.fr, Tel.: +33 4 79 35 21 96)
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Sports hall/sports building is generally within sbp’s scope, but presumably with rather conventional spans
- General planning contract (maîtrise d'oeuvre) already fully awarded, structural design is very likely included in the package
- Medium-sized regional project in France, with no indication of exceptional structural complexity
- No connection to the DACH market or to strategic target regions such as Africa
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project is located in France, where checking engineer services are usually organized differently than in Germany
- No indications of particular size or complexity of the roof or hall structure
- No separate contract for structural checking or independent verification apparent
- The fee volume for the maîtrise d'oeuvre indicates a limited project scope
baukosten_erklaerung: No information on construction costs; based on the fee (82560 EUR), no reliable cost estimate can be derived without further information.
naechste_schritte: No active steps recommended. Monitor the project, but do not initiate contact, as the general planner/engineering services (including structural design) have already been awarded to GROUPEMENT CHANEAC / BECO and no separate lot for checking engineer or structural design is apparent.
notes: CPV 71250000 indicates combined architectural and engineering services; the term “Mission de maîtrise d'oeuvre” suggests a complete planning package including structural design. Award criteria: 45% technical, 55% price. 11 tenders received. No indication of EU co-financing or special architectural/structural engineering ambitions in the notice.
